subject: Maths
title: Percentage increase and decrease
subtitle: Decimals and Percentages · KS3 Maths
learning_objective: I can increase or decrease an amount by a given percentage.

key_vocab.definition: A percentage increase means adding that percentage of the original. A percentage decrease means subtracting it.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can increase or decrease an amount by a given percentage.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: percentage increase -- A percentage increase means adding that percentage of the original. A percentage decrease means subtracting it.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Increase: multiply by (1 + rate). Decrease: multiply by (1 − rate).
New = Original × multiplier; e.g. +20% → ×1.20
Multiplier = 1 ± percentage as decimal

Key examples:
  ✓ Increase £200 by 10% = £220  (× 1.10)
  ✓ Decrease £80 by 25% = £60  (× 0.75)
  ✓ Multiplier for +30% is 1.30  (1 + 0.30)
  ✗ Increase by 20% means × 20  (should be × 1.20)
  ✗ Decrease by 10% → × 0.10  (should be × 0.90)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – percentage increase
  Increase £250 by 20%.
  20% of 250 = 50
  250 + 50 = 300
  Or: 250 × 1.20 = £300
  = £300
  (Add the percentage to the original.)

Example 2 – percentage decrease
  Decrease £180 by 15%.
  15% of 180 = 27
  180 − 27 = 153
  Or: 180 × 0.85 = £153
  = £153
  (Subtract the percentage from the original.)

sections.title: Percentage increase
sections.content:
Increase each amount by the given percentage.

(a) £100 by 10%
(b) £60 by 25%
(c) £200 by 15%
(d) £450 by 20%

sections.title: Percentage decrease
sections.content:
Decrease each amount by the given percentage.

(a) £80 by 10%
(b) £120 by 25%
(c) £500 by 30%
(d) £240 by 5%

sections.title: Multiplier method
sections.content:
Write the multiplier and calculate the new amount.

(a) £300 increased by 12%
(b) £150 decreased by 8%
(c) £90 increased by 35%
(d) £400 decreased by 17.5%

sections.title: Word problems
sections.content:
Find the new amount.

(a) Rent £800/month increases 5%
(b) Car worth £12,000 depreciates 20%
(c) Population 50,000 grows 3%
(d) Price £45 + 20% VAT

sections.title: Mixed increase/decrease
sections.content:
Calculate each.

(a) £160 increased by 30%
(b) £95 decreased by 40%
(c) 500 g increased by 12%
(d) £72 decreased by 33&frac{1}{3}%
(e) £1000 increased by 7.5%

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ Increase by 20% means multiply by 1.20
✗ Decrease by 10% means multiply by 0.10
✓ A 50% decrease halves the amount
✓ Increase by 100% doubles the amount
✗ A 25% increase then 25% decrease returns to original
